import unittest

from solution import TaskBatch


class TaskBatchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_new_batch_add_fifo_and_deep_copy(self):
        batch = TaskBatch()
        self.assertFalse(batch.closed)
        self.assertEqual(len(batch), 0)
        first = {"items": [[1], [2]]}
        second = ["next"]
        batch.add(first)
        batch.add(second)
        first["items"][0].append(99)
        second.append("changed")
        self.assertEqual(len(batch), 2)
        drained = batch.drain()
        self.assertEqual(drained, [{"items": [[1], [2]]}, ["next"]])
        self.assertIsNot(drained[0], first)
        self.assertIsNot(drained[0]["items"], first["items"])
        self.assertEqual(len(batch), 0)

    def test_close_is_idempotent_and_preserves_queue(self):
        batch = TaskBatch()
        batch.add({"a": 1})
        batch.close()
        batch.close()
        self.assertTrue(batch.closed)
        self.assertEqual(len(batch), 1)
        self.assertEqual(batch.drain(), [{"a": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(batch.drain(), [])

    def test_drain_works_while_open_and_batch_remains_usable(self):
        batch = TaskBatch()
        batch.add([1])
        returned = batch.drain()
        returned[0].append(2)
        batch.add([3])
        self.assertEqual(batch.drain(), [[3]])
        self.assertFalse(batch.closed)

    def test_add_after_close_raises_without_copying(self):
        class ExplodesOnCopy:
            def __deepcopy__(self, memo):
                raise AssertionError("payload was copied")

        batch = TaskBatch()
        batch.close()
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            batch.add(ExplodesOnCopy())
        self.assertEqual(len(batch), 0)

    def test_closed_property_is_read_only(self):
        batch = TaskBatch()
        with self.assertRaises(AttributeError):
            batch.closed = True
        self.assertFalse(batch.closed)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
